note: *às vossas tendas*: the blind reader heard market stalls. Kept by the *tabernáculum* row; *aos vossos tabernáculos* is the option.

*E entrarei até o altar de Deus*, held against the Latinist and the stylist, who ask *entrarei ao*. DO's Portuguese Ordo has *irei até ao*. The line priest and server say daily; your ear decides (D42, HANDOFF 21).
